scope: Predeclared two-pass diagnostic, dense operators for numerical study; no production CPU claim

protocol.purpose: Test whether a small reconstructed spectral correction captures useful finite-precision stabilization after charging its replay cost.
protocol.representation: Keep the initial actual kernel columns; add at most four learned vectors and count all additional retained and transient storage.
protocol.selection: Largest Ritz values; identify relative duplicates at sqrt(machine epsilon), then verify physical independence using the reconstructed M-Gram matrix.
protocol.scalar_lanczos_convention: For q_i=z_i/sqrt(rho_i), use negative off-diagonals; preserve first-pass alpha, beta, rho and operation order during replay.
protocol.replay: Twenty sequential operator products, with every preconditioner application and vector accumulation counted. No change of recurrence or reorthogonalization during replay.
protocol.small_matrices: Normalize independent reconstructed modes in the M metric; recompute T=U^T A U from actual reconstructed images.
protocol.initial_correction: x <- x + U T^{-1} U^T r; verify its true residual and include a correction-only old-preconditioner control.
methods: coarse correction followed by old preconditioner
coarse correction followed by balanced Ritz-LMP
protocol.strong_controls: Unpreconditioned CG, compact RP and Gaussian-power factors using the same retained-vector allowance; use each LMP representation actual retained state to determine the control rank.
protocol.balanced_storage: A boundary-vector implementation is allowed only after validating the Lanczos residual relation against actual A-images. Full U/AU storage is a separately counted reference, not a free substitute.
checks: true original relative residual at most 1e-8
retained and transient storage including candidate vectors
protocol.decision: Advance only if continuation savings repay replay and survive storage-matched strong controls. No prefix/rank/threshold sweep after a negative result.
protocol.novelty_boundary: Spectral-LMP, Ritz-LMP, same-solve recycling and two-pass Lanczos reconstruction are established. This experiment establishes neither novelty nor success of the project by itself.

implementation_choices.matched_rank_rule: largest compact factor rank with actual retained numerical payload <= LMP bytes
implementation_choices.actual_A_images: one dense block product, charged as d operator RHS; replay remains20 sequential products
implementation_choices.diagnostic_products: extra explicit raw-relation A products and all verification inverse applications recorded separately and included in all-work totals
